name: @webdesk/database
description: The SOLE Sequelize model/connection/migration implementation boundary (WDS-011, ADR-0006). Phase 1B: real Sequelize/PostgreSQL connection, migration framework, transaction and repository foundations, proven against a minimal test-only model — no business entities (projects/users) yet, those require a separate authorization (docs/task-packages/phase-1b-database-foundation.md §9/§24). See docs/architecture/decisions/0006-postgresql-sequelize-architecture.md and 0007-database-provider-independence-east-coast.md.

scripts.migrate:test: pnpm build && node dist/migrate.js up && node dist/migrate.js down
